t: This is Gray's Inn, one of the four Inns of Court. Anyone who wants to practise as a barrister in England and Wales must belong to one of them. It stands where High Holborn meets Gray's Inn Road, and it provides offices and some homes for barristers. It's known for its gardens, which have existed since at least 1597. Two people died here. Edmund Gennings, a Catholic priest from Lichfield, was executed during the English Reformation and is remembered as a martyr. James Davidson was an English lawyer and antiquarian.
